test_scenarios.name: in_band_reset
test_scenarios.observe: Link returns to Single I/O, 20 MHz, CRC disabled (spec §5/§12)

test_scenarios.name: status_poll
test_scenarios.observe: 16-bit STATUS register FREE/AVAIL bits per channel (spec §6/§7)

test_scenarios.name: config_readback
test_scenarios.stimulus: Issue GET_CONFIGURATION (0x22) at a config offset
test_scenarios.observe: Negotiated operating frequency / I/O mode / CRC enable read back (spec §8)

test_scenarios.name: crc_check
test_scenarios.stimulus: Send a frame with a corrupted CRC byte
test_scenarios.observe: Optional CRC-8 (poly 0x07) detects the bit error; NON_FATAL_ERROR (0x02) response (spec §6/§10)

test_scenarios.name: wait_state_observe
test_scenarios.stimulus: Address a slave that is not ready to respond
test_scenarios.observe: Slave inserts WAIT_STATE (0x0F nibble) bytes before the response code (spec §11)
